import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame with missing values
data = {
    "quantity": [10.0, None, 20.0, None, 30.0],
    "region": ["North", None, "South", "East", None]
}
pdf = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(pdf)

# Clean missing values
df_clean = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("quantity").fill_null(0),
    nw.col("region").fill_null("unknown")
])

# Convert back to native and display
result = nw.to_native(df_clean)
print(result)
